sender.ms: SMS atau WhatsApp yang mengaku daripada Pos Malaysia, Ninja Van atau syarikat kurier lain
sender.en: A text or WhatsApp message claiming to be from Pos Malaysia, Ninja Van or another courier

name.ms: Bungkusan “gagal dihantar”: bayar yuran kecil di pautan
name.en: Parcel “could not be delivered”: pay a small fee through a link

how.ms: Anda menerima SMS atau WhatsApp mengatakan bungkusan anda tidak dapat dihantar, alamat tidak lengkap, atau perlu menukar tarikh penghantaran, dengan pautan. Laman itu meminta “yuran penghantaran semula” yang sangat kecil, seperti RM1.37 atau RM1.75, dan butiran kad atau perbankan anda. Selepas bayaran, jumlah yang jauh lebih besar diambil dari akaun anda. Pos Malaysia menyatakan mesej palsu ini juga meminta anda mengemas kini butiran bank atau memuat turun fail APK.
how.en: You get a text or WhatsApp message saying your parcel could not be delivered, the address is incomplete, or the delivery date must be changed, with a link. The page asks for a very small “redelivery fee”, such as RM1.37 or RM1.75, and your card or banking details. After you pay, a much bigger amount is taken from your account. Pos Malaysia says these fake messages also ask you to update bank details or download APK files.

text.ms: Mesej daripada “kurier” mengatakan bungkusan anda tertangguh.
text.en: A message from a “courier” says your parcel is held up.

text.ms: Anda perlu bertindak hari ini atau bungkusan dipulangkan.
text.en: You must act today or the parcel is returned.

text.ms: Pautan membawa ke laman palsu yang meminta yuran kecil dan butiran kad atau bank.
text.en: The link opens a fake page that asks for a small fee and your card or bank details.

text.ms: Laman itu meminta OTP, dan jumlah besar ditolak dari akaun anda.
text.en: The page asks for an OTP, and a large amount is taken from your account.

text.ms: PosMalaysia: Bungkusan anda tidak dapat dihantar kerana alamat tidak lengkap. Sila kemas kini alamat dan bayar caj penghantaran semula RM1.75 dalam masa 24 jam di [pautan]
text.en: PosMalaysia: Your parcel could not be delivered because the address is incomplete. Please update your address and pay the RM1.75 redelivery charge within 24 hours at [pautan]

ms: sms bungkusan tak dapat dihantar minta bayar caj
bayar rm1 untuk hantar semula bungkusan tapi duit banyak hilang
pos malaysia minta kemas kini alamat melalui pautan
kurier palsu minta butiran kad untuk penghantaran

en: text says parcel could not be delivered and asks for a charge
paid rm1 to redeliver a parcel but lost a lot of money
pos malaysia asks me to update my address through a link
fake courier asked for my card details for delivery
link to change delivery date asked for an otp

ms: Yuran penghantaran semula yang sangat kecil yang dibayar melalui pautan.
Mesej yang tidak menyebut nombor penghantaran sebenar anda.
Laman “kurier” yang meminta butiran kad, perbankan atau OTP.
en: A tiny redelivery fee paid through a link.
A message that does not mention your real tracking number.
A “courier” page that asks for card or banking details or an OTP.

ms: Jangan tekan pautan itu. Semak bungkusan anda di aplikasi atau laman rasmi kurier, dengan menaip alamatnya sendiri.
Jangan masukkan butiran kad atau OTP di laman yang dibuka daripada SMS.
Jika sudah membayar, hubungi bank anda untuk menyekat kad, kemudian hubungi 997.
en: Don't tap the link. Check your parcel in the courier's official app or website, typing the address yourself.
Don't enter card details or an OTP on a page opened from a text message.
If you already paid, call your bank to block your card, then call 997.

sources.title: Small ‘delivery fee’ leads to big loss
Postal Forum Urges Public Vigilance Against Rising Postal And Delivery Scams

story.ms: Seorang pelanggan Pos Malaysia menerima SMS bahawa bungkusannya tidak dapat dihantar, dengan pautan untuk menukar tarikh penghantaran tetapi tanpa butiran penghantaran. Laman itu meminta yuran penghantaran semula RM1.37; apabila dia membayar, caj RM2,334.58 dikenakan dan wang itu dikeluarkan dari akaunnya.
story.en: A Pos Malaysia customer got a text saying her parcel could not be delivered, with a link to change the delivery date but no shipment details. The page asked for a RM1.37 redelivery fee; when she paid, a charge of RM2,334.58 was made and the money was taken from her account.
